rationale: GE-WEORHT (from weorcan, 'to work/make') denotes something made or accomplished — a deed or product of effort — which aligns with work.n.02 ('a product produced or accomplished through the effort or activity or agency of a person or thing'). The ge- prefix in Old English typically marks a resultant or completed state, strongly suggesting the outcome/product sense rather than the ongoing activity sense of work.n.01.
